explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/945, which presents the interval formulation as a restatement ('In other words …') of F(x) ≤ (log x)^{O(1)}. The Lean statement Erdos945Prop ↔ Erdos945Constant asserts this equivalence, tagged textbook. I checked that it is correct: if F(y) ≤ (log y)^C eventually, an interval [x, x + (log x)^{C'}] with C' > C contains more consecutive integers than F allows to have distinct τ; conversely, if every such interval beyond x₀ contains a repeated τ-value, any run of distinct τ-values below x has length at most x₀ + (log x)^C + 1. Correct.
